Class BuildingDeck

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.card.BuildingDeck
public class BuildingDeck extends Object
The building card deck, partitioned by era. On construction, all building cards are shuffled within each era and trimmed to the player-count-appropriate quantity.
